answer: Relic-Mirror Handshake: each agent holds a tamper-evident relic—a monotonic counter with a unique unclonable key under an ivory-colored seal. Each epoch it signs counter+1 and posts a hash mirror to a shared log. A clone reuses the same relic state, producing two divergent mirror entries; the log’s equivocation proof flags both. Attacker cost: one manufactured tamper-proof relic per successful sybil, plus forfeiture of all clones when the collision is published.
